name: Holy Light
desc: Active — Restore 3 health to your hero or a friendly creature, then create a 1/1 Recruit.

name: Time Reversal
desc: Active — Blink a friendly creature. Its enter effects trigger again.

name: Soul Reaper
desc: Active — Sacrifice a non-Commander creature, then return a creature costing up to 1 more from your graveyard to play.

name: Flame Burst
desc: Active — Deal 3 damage to any target, plus 1 for each noncreature spell cast this turn (maximum +3).

name: Wild Growth
desc: Active — Play up to 2 additional lands from your reserve this turn, then untap up to 2 lands.

name: Adaptive Bloom
desc: Active — Give a friendly creature Warform, Mindform, or Lifebloom this turn. Already-morphed creatures receive the stronger form.
